## Load data

### FLIP
```{r}
FLIP_Clinical <- read_csv(here("Data/FLIP1_ClinicalData.csv"))
# FLIP <-clean_names(FLIP)

FLIP_MicrobiomeParams <- read_csv(here("Data/Microbiome_Parameters_FLIP_VMET2.csv"))

FLIP_Data <- merge(FLIP_Clinical, FLIP_MicrobiomeParams, by='Sequencing Name')


# Omit edge cases of pregnancy with rescue cerclage samping and T6A and T3.5
FLIP_Data <- subset(FLIP_Data, Timepoint %in% c("T0", "T1", "T2", "T3", "T4", "T5", "T6"))
FLIP_Data <- subset(FLIP_Data, `Sample Name` != 'E29')
FLIP_Data <- subset(FLIP_Data, `Sample Name` != 'E186')
```

# Assignment of responder vs non-responder using clustering
```{r}
set.seed(12)
# Identify flip_numbers with duplicate timepoints
duplicate_timepoints <- FLIP_Data %>%
  group_by(`FLIP number`, Timepoint) %>%
  tally(name = "count") %>%
  filter(count > 1)

# subset(FLIP_Data, `FLIP number` == "F005")[, c("Sample Name", "FLIP number", "Gestational Age", "Timepoint")]

# Repeated sample names 
samples_to_remove <- c("E185", "E29")

FLIP_Data_NoDuplicateTP <- FLIP_Data %>%
  filter(!(`Sample Name` %in% samples_to_remove))

FLIP_Data_NoDuplicateTP <- FLIP_Data_NoDuplicateTP %>%
  filter(Timepoint %in% c("T0", "T1", "T2", "T3", "T4", "T5", "T6"))

FLIP_Data_NoDuplicateTP <- FLIP_Data_NoDuplicateTP %>% 
  filter(`Sample Type` == "Participant sample")

FLIP_Data_NoDuplicateTP <- FLIP_Data_NoDuplicateTP %>%
  mutate(log_lac_v_copies = log10(FLIP_Data_NoDuplicateTP$`LactinV_16S_CopyNo/mL`))

wide_data <- FLIP_Data_NoDuplicateTP %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = `FLIP number`,
    names_from = Timepoint,  values_from = log_lac_v_copies)


# Remove patient_id column before clustering
data_for_clustering <- wide_data[,-1] 

# Replace NAs with the mean of each row (i.e., patient's average)
clean_data <- data_for_clustering %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), mean(., na.rm = TRUE), .)))

# Check recommended number of clusters using the silhouette score
silhouette_score <-function(k){
  km <- kmeans(clean_data, centers = k, nstart = 25)
  ss <- silhouette(km$cluster, dist(clean_data))
  mean(ss[, 3])}

k <- 2:10
avg_sil <- sapply(k, silhouette_score)

silhouette_plot <- ggplot(NULL, aes(x = k, y = avg_sil)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(x = "Number of Clusters",
    y = "Average Silhouette Score",
    title = "Silhouette Method") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

# k = 2 optimal
kmeans_result <- kmeans(clean_data, centers = 2)

# Add cluster labels back to wide_data
wide_data$cluster <- kmeans_result$cluster
wide_data$cluster <- as.factor(kmeans_result$cluster)

long_data <- melt(wide_data, id.vars = c("FLIP number", "cluster"),
                  variable.name = "Timepoint", value.name = "value")

timepoint_levels <- c("T0", "T1", "T2", "T3", "T4", "T5", "T6")
long_data$tTmepoint <- factor(long_data$Timepoint, levels = timepoint_levels, ordered = TRUE)


# Plot
clustering <- ggplot(long_data, aes(x = factor(Timepoint, levels=c("T0", "T1", "T2", "T3", "T4", "T5", "T6")), 
                                    y = value, group = `FLIP number`, color = cluster)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(title = "Patient Trajectories by Cluster", y= "log10(Lactin-V)") +
  theme_minimal()


clustering_k2 <- ggplot(long_data, aes(x = factor(Timepoint, levels=c("T0", "T1", "T2", "T3", "T4", "T5", "T6")),
                                       y =log10(value), group = `FLIP number`)) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = cluster), width = 0.2, size = 2) +  
  geom_line(aes(color = cluster), linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("1" =  "#619CFF", "2" =  "#00BA38")) + #, "3" ="#F8766D")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Timepoint", y = "lo10(Lactin-V copies/ml)") +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 22),legend.position = "right")

 
# Create a lookup table: flip_number → cluster
clusters <- wide_data %>%
  select(`FLIP number`, cluster)

# Merge cluster info into the long-format dataset
FLIP_Data <- FLIP_Data %>%
  left_join(clusters, by = "FLIP number")

FLIP_Data <- FLIP_Data %>% mutate(Responder = case_when(cluster == "1" ~ "Non-responder",
                                                   cluster == "2" ~ "Responder"))
table(FLIP_Data$Responder)
```

# Responder vs non-Responder
```{r}
FLIP_Data_Plot <- FLIP_Data %>%
  filter(Timepoint %in% c("T0", "T1", "T2", "T3", "T4", "T5", "T6"))

FLIP_Data_Plot <- FLIP_Data_Plot %>% 
  filter(`Sample Type` == "Participant sample")


clustering_k2 <- ggplot(FLIP_Data_Plot, aes(x = factor(Timepoint), y =log10(`LactinV_16S_CopyNo/mL`), group = `FLIP number`)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Responder), width = 0.2, size = 2) + 
  geom_line(aes(color = Responder), linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Responder" = "#619CFF", "Non-responder" = "coral"),
    labels = c("Responder" = "Yes", "Non-responder" = "No"),
    name = "Lactin-V colonisation") + 
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Timepoint", y = "lo10(Lactin-V copies/ml)") +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 22), legend.position = "right",
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour="white"))

ggsave(here('./Figures/LactV_Clusters.png'), clustering_k2, dpi=300, width=10, height=8)
ggsave(here('./Figures/LactV_Clusters.svg'), clustering_k2, dpi=300, width=10, height=8)
```
```{r}

FLIP_Data_Plot <- FLIP_Data_Plot %>%
  group_by(`FLIP number`) %>%
  filter(any(Timepoint == "T0")) %>%
  arrange(Timepoint) %>%
  mutate(
    CST_at_T0 = first(CST[Timepoint == "T0"]),
    CST_I_at_T0 = ifelse(CST_at_T0 == "I", "CST I", "Other")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


clustering_lactV_CST <- ggplot(FLIP_Data_Plot, aes(x = factor(Timepoint), y =log10(`LactinV_16S_CopyNo/mL`), group = `FLIP number`)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Responder), width = 0.2, size = 2) + 
  geom_line(aes(color = Responder), linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.6)  +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Responder" = "#619CFF", "Non-responder" = "coral"),
    labels = c("Responder" = "Yes", "Non-responder" = "No"),
    name = "Lactin-V colonisation") + 
  theme_minimal() +
  facet_wrap(~CST_at_T0) +
  labs(x = "Timepoint", y = "lo10(Lactin-V copies/ml)") +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 22), legend.position = "right", 
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour="white"))


ggsave(here('./Figures/LactV_Clusters_CST.png'), clustering_lactV_CST, dpi=300, width=10, height=8)
ggsave(here('./Figures/LactV_Clusters_CST.svg'), clustering_lactV_CST, dpi=300, width=10, height=8)


```



####Is initial CST important for responder status?
```{r}
FLIP_t0 <- FLIP_Data_Plot %>% filter(FLIP_Data_Plot$Timepoint == "T0")

table_cst <- table(FLIP_t0$Responder, FLIP_t0$CST)
chisquared<- chisq.test(table_cst)
p_value<- chisquared$p.value



initial_cst_vsResponder <- ggplot(FLIP_t0, aes(fill = CST, x = Responder)) +
              geom_bar(position = "fill", stat = "count") + 
              scale_fill_manual(values = c("#228b22","#66cdaa","#ffcc00", "#b22222",
                                             "#c62828","#ffc0cb", "#800080", "gray")) + 
              theme_light() +  xlab("Lactin-V colonisation") + ylab("Count")+ labs(fill = "Valencia CST")+
              geom_text(stat = "count", aes(label = ..count..), position = position_fill(vjust = 0.5),
              color = "white", size = 5) +
              scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Responder" = "Yes", "Non-responder" = "No")) +
              theme(text = element_text(size = 20), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, vjust = 0.5)) +
              annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 1.05,label = paste0("Chi-squared p = ", signif(p_value, 3)), size = 6)


ggsave(here("Figures", "FLIP_initial_CST.png"), initial_cst_vsResponder, width =6, height = 9, dpi = 300)
ggsave(here("Figures", "FLIP_initial_CST.svg"), initial_cst_vsResponder, width =6, height = 9, dpi = 300)
```
